# orchestration_context_tool

> Get context about a workflow execution and its current stage.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `orchestration` |
| Callable | MCP clients; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=orchestration_context_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Get context about a workflow execution and its current stage. Returns stage info,
expected outputs, available artifacts with LlmFile IDs, and execution context.

Use this at the start of your stage to understand what you need to do and what
prior stages have produced.

LIST MODE: call WITHOUT orchestration_execution_id to list recent executions for
this tenant (optionally filtered by template_name and/or status). Use this to find
a run when you don't know its execution ID — e.g. to diagnose "my run failed":
list, find the run by name/time, then call again with its ID for full detail
(failed runs include failure_reason).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orchestration_execution_id` | integer | no | The ID of the OrchestrationExecution. Omit to LIST recent executions instead. |
| `orchestration_stage_execution_id` | integer | no | Optional: specific stage execution ID to get details for. |
| `template_name` | string | no | List mode: only executions of the template with this exact name. |
| `status` | string | no | List mode: only executions with this current status (e.g. orch_running, orch_failed, orch_completed) |
| `limit` | integer | no | List mode: max executions to return (default 10, max 50) |
